title: S028 — Authoritative Phase-A dependency completeness audit
description: Determine the complete set of authoritative Phase-A dependencies actually required to know which previously decided nodes must be reconsidered, derived from what the implementation actually reads.
result_summary: PASS. Audited the authoritative Phase-A reads (positiveFixpoint -> nodeSupport -> hardSupport / factNodeTruth / factWindowTruth). FINDING: the S027 Ordos residual (mismatch=38, R\closure=67) was caused by a MISSING DEPENDENCY EDGE, not an unknown semantic class - S027's directChanged OMITTED the overriddenCells delta (the facts in a changed cell). factNodeTruth reads model.overriddenCells via cellKey, so an override changes a fact node's truth; without that delta the fact and its dependents stayed outside the reset closure. Adding the override delta: ordos V1/V2/V3/V5 all reach mismatch=0 and R\closure=0; Verrin was already 0 in S027. COMPLETE dependency set: supportGroups, enablesIn, excludesEdges, invariantEdges, precedesEdges, validity windows (validFrom/validTo -> fact node), overriddenCells (cell -> fact node), nodeIds/edge endpoints, negated/forcedBy, retracted. Exactly one class was missing: overriddenCells. CLASSIFICATION: A - locally incrementalisable Phase A. No incremental engine, no second evaluator, no alternative dependency interpretation.
complete_dependency_set: overriddenCells (cell -> fact node) - the class S027 missed
next_experiment: implement the event-driven incremental Phase-A engine using the validated dependency index and S021's exact support aggregates, and prove prefix-by-prefix equivalence.
limitations: Ordos was the only canon re-run in S028 (Verrin was already 0 in S027); the randomized history corpus and the S024 synthetic SCC/OR corpus were not re-run.
Determinism and branch isolation hold by construction but were not independently measured.
The S027/S028 discrepancy is a harness difference (directChanged composition), not a semantic discovery.
